name: generate_stirrup_distribution
author: hprebar
title: Calculate Parametric Stirrup Distribution along Framing Axis
description: Calculate zoned stirrup reinforcement distribution and bar counts across support and mid-span zones along a structural beam without creating rebar elements.
notes: Calculates zoned stirrup distribution (support dense and mid-span sparse zones) along beam span length.

beamElementId.description: Element ID of host structural beam.

denseSpacingMm.description: Dense stirrup spacing near supports in millimeters.

sparseSpacingMm.description: Sparse stirrup spacing in mid-span in millimeters.

supportZoneRatio.description: Span fraction for dense support zone (e.g. 0.25 for L/4).
